get_inside.text: To reach the City of Um use:
Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.

Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.

Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.
City of Um Teleport to teleport directly to the ritual site, which requires five spirit runes and completion of Rune Mythos.
Underworld Grimoire offers a variety of teleports for completing corresponding tiers of the Underworld achievements:
The Underworld Grimoire 1 has 10 daily teleports to the City of Um smithy.
The Underworld Grimoire 2 adds unlimited teleports to the City of Um smithy and 10 free daily teleports shared between the Um and Ungael ritual sites.
The Underworld Grimoire 3 adds unlimited teleports to the ritual sites.
The Underworld Grimoire 4 adds a daily teleport to Lupe.
Passing bracelet to:
Hanging Gardens, to the east.
Haunt on the Hill, to the north-east near the owlery and the dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple.
Reflection Pool, to the south.
Outside of the main district there is a number of other points of interest:
The dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple, used to craft the necrotic runes at level 24 Necromancy.

South of the main district and east of the docks is the graveyard, which is where the priestess Selene resides and is able to teach the adventurer necromancy prayers. The graveyard is full of shrines to honour the living; some City of Um residents light candles in these shrines to watch over their living loved ones as they wait for them to pass to the Underworld.
In the graveyard area there's also a troll cave where a variety of ghostly trolls can be killed. The cave also contains the entrance to Trollgrav.
There is a bakery owned by Dominique who sometimes is in town. They ask the player for a century egg, bonemeal, and curdled milk to create a deathday cake as part of a City of Um achievement.

The City of Um is located on Lake Mnemosyne. Players are able to rent boats or get a free boat tour from Ed to explore the lake or learn more about the City of Um. During a boat tour, it is revealed that the many shipwrecks surrounding Um among the jagged rocks in the lake were imagined into existence by the sailors and pirates who passed into the Underworld. Tavia can be spotted fishing on the far eastern shore of Um, visible only from the lake by boat.

The owlery is located in the north-east of the city next to the Haunt on the Hill (dark portal) station of the City of Um ferry system. At level 75 Necromancy new residents are unlocked which include the fallen heroes of the While Guthix Sleeps quest (Turael, Ghommal, Duradel, Sloane, Cyrisus, and Hazelmere) that can be interacted to power the Well of Souls with 150 souls.

The Hanging Gardens are located in the east of the city, east of Kili and south of the dark portal. At 80 Necromancy, a mushroom patch and a compost bin will be functional, and Hemlock, a gardener who functions as a tool leprechaun, and a retired tool leprechaun will also arrive.
